title: Scalable Keyword Spotting via Modular Network Expansion
abstract: Keyword spotting (KWS) models on embedded devices often need to add new keywords after deployment, but updates are difficult when original training data are unavailable and regressions on existing triggers are unacceptable. At a fixed operating point, our method reduces average new-keyword false reject rate (FRR) from 6.46% to 4.37% versus a parameter-matched separate-model baseline and outperforms parameter-efficient tuning baselines (adapters, LoRA), while using fewer multiply-accumulate operations (MACs) under the same added-parameter budget (≤10k): 16.34M vs 18.45M/20.52M. We achieve this via parameter-capped modular expansion: the base network, including batch-normalization statistics and the core classifier, is frozen, and only a lightweight expansion branch with a separate new-keyword head is trained, preserving core logits, shipped outputs, and thresholds for existing keywords.
tldr_cn: 该文冻结原关键词检测路径并增加轻量分支，让设备可扩展新词且保持旧词输出不变。

analysis.研究动机: 嵌入式关键词检测器部署后常需增加触发词，但原训练数据可能无法再用；直接微调还可能损害已有关键词识别。
analysis.解决问题: 如何在不访问旧训练数据、新增参数不超过 10k 的条件下增加关键词，同时严格保持旧关键词输出不变。
analysis.现象分析: 冻结原网络并增加轻量分支可在结构上保持旧关键词 logits 不变。五组关键词扩展实验中，新词平均 FRR 为 4.37%，低于参数匹配的独立模型基线 6.46%；新增分支 MACs 为 16.34M，低于 Adapter 的 18.45M 和 LoRA 的 20.52M。
analysis.主要方法: 冻结 SVDF 风格基础网络及其归一化统计量，通过扩展块读取冻结层激活，再接独立新词分类头；推理时先运行原关键词检测器，只有其拒识时才评估新词头。
analysis.数据与实验: 使用 Google Speech Commands v2 的十个关键词和五组留出词对；Mozilla Common Voice v17 仅用作负样本以校准 1% FAR 阈值。各配置运行八个随机种子。
analysis.主要贡献: 提出参数受限的模块化关键词扩展方法，并以冻结原路径的设计提供旧词行为不变保证。新词识别相较独立小模型、Adapter 和 LoRA 基线更有效率；实验仍基于指定数据集和关键词任务。
